biggest_catch: You only get paid if your friend meets one of the activity criteria within 30 days of joining (active direct deposit, funded loan, credit card with 5+ transactions, or active debit card with 5+ transactions) AND mentions your referral at account opening. If they forget to say they were referred, there is no payout — referrals can't be claimed retroactively.
catches: Referred member must within 30 days of joining: pay the $10 membership fee, sign all documents, AND meet one of: active direct deposit, approved/funded loan, approved credit card with 5+ transactions, or active debit card with 5+ transactions.
Referred member must state at account opening that they were referred; post-opening claims are not accepted.
Cap: 20 referrals ($500 maximum) per member per calendar year.
Both accounts must be in good standing at payout; delinquent accounts are ineligible.
Existing members in the CU's system are ineligible (beneficiaries excepted).
Program may be modified, suspended, or terminated at any time without prior notice.
Tax treatment not stated; treat as potentially reportable income.

steps: Confirm you are a current Community First Federal Credit Union member in good standing.
Tell a friend about the credit union and have them open a membership, stating at account opening that you referred them.

Friend funds the account ($10 membership fee), signs documents, and within 30 days completes one qualifying activity: active direct deposit, approved/funded loan, approved credit card with 5+ transactions, or active debit card with 5+ transactions.
You receive a $25 reward deposited after the 30-day review, up to 20 referrals ($500) per calendar year.
timing: Accounts reviewed after the 30-day timeframe; reward deposited within the first week following review.
